status: Conditional electrical review; no physical bus or power-sequencing qualification

sources.STUSB4500: ST DS12499 Rev8 Tables1,21,22 and section2.2.14; https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stusb4500.pdf
sources.BQ25798: TI SLUSDV2C pin21 and section6.5 Digital IO; https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25798.pdf

interrupt.missing_bound: ST ALERT leakage is unspecified. BQ leakage is tested at1.8V and MCU DC table at3.3V/25C. The10uA total is a qualification allowance, not a guaranteed part maximum.

i2c.limit: The maximum-table low levels do not establish positive ST input margin. Qualify actual low level, 100kHz rise/fall, cable capacitance, 150ohm pack series drop and all powered/unpowered states.

vsys.connection: Direct host3.3V to ST pin22; raw VDD/deadbattery retained
vsys.limits: No reverse-current bound, USB-to-host backfeed, rail-collapse or depleted-pack startup proof. New VSYS capacitance is on host rail, not directly rawVBUS; the old raw-local capacitance subtotal is not a system inrush bound.
